articles.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
articles.summary: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.

articles.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
articles.summary: The new ASSX fund offers 2x daily exposure to Strive shares, giving traders a leveraged way to bet on the Bitcoin treasury company.

articles.title: Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: Reports
articles.summary: Trump posted on Truth Social that his new project would manage the fast-growing sector without adding regulations that could slow innovation.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: Ripple says asset managers are preparing for XRP Ledger’s next payments upgrade
articles.summary: The upcoming Batch V1.1 can make linked asset and payment transfers succeed together or fail together, and Ripple says commercial projects are already being built around the feature after an extensive security review.

articles.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF files for 3-for-1 forward share split
articles.summary: At the close of trading on Sept. 28, shareholders will receive two extra shares for each one they hold.

articles.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
articles.summary: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.

articles.title: 'The orange tie stays': Michael Saylor responds to venture capitalist's bitcoin obituary
articles.summary: "Bitcoin feels like the CD in the age of Spotify, the DVD in the age of Netflix," wrote Jason Calacanis.

articles.title: Why Wall Street giants build tokenization money for institutions, not regular consumers
articles.summary: JPMorgan and Citi move billions in tokenized deposits, but only among their branches. A U.K. challenger bank is about to do something neither has done.

articles.title: Hong Kong jails ex-banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
articles.summary: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.

articles.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
articles.summary: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

articles.title: Clarity Act, we hardly knew ye: We look at what was in the bill and what's replacing it
articles.summary: U.S. agencies are racing to substitute their regulations for the law that was meant to set crypto markets in governmental bedrock, but will the stand-ins last?

articles.title: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
articles.summary: VanEck said Metaplanet’s executive equity exposure remains well above its digital asset treasury peers, even after the company cut its potential share pool by 41%.

articles.title: Anthropic tabs Accenture as embedded evaluator to help with AI slowdown proposal
articles.summary: The partnership is non-exclusive, and Anthropic expects to announce other evaluators in forthcoming weeks with which it will also work.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.summary: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.

articles.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase with own filing for US stock perpetual futures
articles.summary: Kalshi’s proposal would bring perpetual futures tied to individual stocks to US traders, as Coinbase and Bitnomial pursue similar products.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain fees collapse 97% even as transactions stay near record highs
articles.summary: Seven-day average fees fell 82% while transaction counts slipped 6%, with about $1.5 billion a day still changing hands.
